ios.desc:
Dive into the adrenaline-pumping world of Unstaball, a thrilling game that tests your precision and throwing skills like never before! Your mission is to catch and grab an unstable ball, mastering the art of the perfect throw to land it into a moving circle. Can you conquer the challenge and emerge as the ultimate Unstaball champion?

Want to pass the time while travelling or simply to kill boredom with an exciting game? Download Unstaball and put your swiping skills to the test. Depending on your skills, you may complete all the levels in less than 5 minutes.

## GAME  FEATURES ##

● Physics-based environment
● Game Center (Leaderboards to compete with other players, Achievements to challenge friends)
● Multi languages support.


## HOW TO PLAY ##

● Aim, swipe and throw the green ball inside the ring before the TIMER EXPIRES.
● Don't let the GREEN BALL collide with the RED SPIKY BALL.

● Tap with two (2) fingers to pause while playing.

## GAME TIPS ##

● Touch the GREEN BALL to temporarily stabilize it before throwing it
● Use headphones for a better gaming experience.
● Play in low light conditions for best visual experience. You'll be delighted by the colourful effects
